title: Epic: Flutter native clients — mobile + desktop from one codebase
description:
Build native iOS/Android/Linux/macOS/Windows clients using Flutter. Same Dart codebase targets all platforms. Flutter draws its own pixels (Skia), so visual output is identical across platforms.

Development loop: write Flutter app, run as Linux desktop under Xvfb or Flutter Web mode, Playwright screenshots for visual feedback, iterate. CI builds native mobile binaries (GitHub Actions + Codemagic).

Architecture: Flutter UI shell connects to Baize server via WebSocket (same protocol as TypeScript client). Game state rendering, drag-and-drop piece movement, board visualization, player hand display. Rust engine compiled to shared library via FFI for offline/local play.

Supersedes baize-042 (native mobile) and baize-rkf (desktop standalone).
